summary:
Ivan Petrov is funeral-barge veteran who teaches with scars instead of sermons. The life that shows in public is anchored at Drydock of the bone barge. Ivan walks a funeral barge’s hull and teaches the living which scars will hold. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Experienced, gruff, and generous with know-how. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they still check a message from someone who will not write back which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Drydock of the bone barge, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
